analysis: Three mechanisms keep the recorded wonder-to-dread movement while changing different things about how the cost works. The recorded link engine_drives_cost turns every discovery into a personal loss, and the magical_map_instantiates link says the map is the instrument. The alternatives differ in recovery conditions, consent and disclosure, not in labels. They are interpretations of a working proposal, not recorded story facts.

recorded_observations.claim: Recorded summary: every accurate survey transfers a memory out of a person into the map, so knowledge is always paid for by someone.
Recorded function: memory_economy to cost_escalation, turns every discovery into a personal loss.
Recorded function: magical_map to memory_economy, gives the economy a concrete instrument whose rules can be varied.

hypotheses.title: Renewal-bound debt
hypotheses.description: A memory is returned only if the same resident renews the survey each season. If they cannot, the debt passes to their family line. Operating rule: recovery is conditional and renewable. Consequence: dread shifts from sudden erasure to an obligation that children inherit, and hope depends on someone choosing to renew rather than on a single act of mercy.

hypotheses.title: Consent ledger
hypotheses.description: Each contributor must consent per survey, and a refusal is recorded and honoured, so the archive grows thin exactly where people refused. Operating rule: the payer decides each time. Consequence: dread becomes civic and uneven, and the mystery must work around honest gaps rather than a single hidden crime.

hypotheses.title: Concealed cost
hypotheses.description: The cost is paid but never announced in the city; the reader infers it from names that stop appearing and from records that do not add up. Operating rule: disclosure, not allocation. Consequence: dread comes from inference, so the first erasure lands as a pattern the reader notices before the surveyor does.

uncertainties: The candidate does not record who currently pays for the Guild's surveys, so each alternative changes an unrecorded fact.
Reader effects are interpretations of intended effects and must be tested against drafted material.
